title: A customer submits the RoleArn without an operator kernel
description:
## Found on `chatticus-b88c0a`

After `create-stack` there is no customer HTTP for `submit_self_setup_cross_account_role`. Operator HTTP is enable/suspend/reinstate only. The only `CrossAccountRoleInspector` is in-memory (Gherkin). The hand run used a labeled `/tmp` kernel script.

## Done when

A pending owner can submit their AWS account id and `ChatticusOrganizationComputerRole` ARN in-product. The live path inspects the role (ExternalId = `tenant_id`, required permissions) and on accept enables the org and writes AWS home. Behavior in Gherkin first. Do not `members seed`.
